name: create-repo
description: Start a new repo for a thread of work — the directory, git init, a README naming its purpose, claude-sandbox init and a first commit — then one copy-paste command that launches an agent session on it to write its CLAUDE.md and run the thread's first investigation (external: the claude-sandbox tool, degrading to a plain claude launch without it; soft dependencies: kit-dev, to scaffold a claude-templates template as the goal; sandbox, to troubleshoot a failed init or launch; dev-flow, whose investigate skill the launched session uses for the first investigation when installed, else it investigates directly).
